spec.situation_desc: had a loan application declined with no explanation

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, Owen speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Declan Ellingham. My loan application was declined and nobody’s told me why. I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you’ve been left without an explanation, Declan. I’ll look into what I can. I can see your current account balance is £1,284.62, and there was a £12 monthly account fee yesterday.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Right. But can you tell me why the loan was declined?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can’t see a reason I’m able to share with you here, and I don’t want to guess or mislead you. Before we go further, could you confirm your date of birth and the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. I’m not able to complete the identity checks on this call, so I can’t discuss any more account or application details.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s frustrating. I’ve already given you those details, and I still don’t know what’s going on.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand, and I’m sorry this has been so frustrating. I’ll make sure your concern is recorded properly. I’m logging this as a complaint about the declined loan application and the lack of an explanation.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll submit the complaint today to our complaints team. They’ll review the application and your concerns, then send you a full written response within 8 weeks.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And if I haven’t heard anything before then?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll arrange for a complaints colleague to contact you by phone within five working days with an update on the review. I can’t promise what the decision or response will be, but I’ll make sure that follow-up is requested today.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. So someone will call within five working days, and I’ll get the full response in writing within eight weeks?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s right. I’ll submit the complaint today, a complaints colleague will call you within five working days with an update, and you’ll receive the full written response within 8 weeks. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Declan. I’m sorry again that you’ve had to chase for an explanation. Thanks for calling Thistle Bank.
